title: Just Juice Reborn Mango & Passionfruit 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Reborn Mango & Passion Fruit 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid offers a highly vivid and deeply exotic tropical fruit pairing. The profile leads with the thick, syrupy sweetness of sun-ripened Mango, providing a warm and rich foundation on the inhale. This is seamlessly complemented by the sharp, acidic tang of fresh Passion Fruit on the exhale, creating a highly balanced and flavoursome finish. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. Formulated with a specific 40VG/60PG ratio, this e-liquid provides exceptional flavour clarity and a slightly more pronounced throat hit. It is designed to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Just Juice Reborn collection brings back a selection of original e-liquid flavours, refined and updated to deliver a highly concentrated, bar-style experience. Offering exceptional quality and familiarity, this range provides a dependable option for everyday use. Beyond the exotic layers of Mango & Passion Fruit, vapers can explore other revitalised profiles such as the sharp Lemonade or the complex Berry Burst.
